dedupe_keys.name: confederacion hidrografica del guadalquivir water datasets

description: Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir: water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Coverage: Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Canales principales de riego en la demarcación hidrográfica del Guadal; Superficies autorizadas para el riego en la demarcación hidrográfica d; Embalses de las demarcaciones hidrográficas del Guadalquivir, Ceuta y ; Presas de las demarcaciones hidrográficas del Guadalquivir, Ceuta y Me. Formats seen: WMS, HTML, PNG, PDF, KML%2BXML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://idechg.chguadalquivir.es/geochg/legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
